purpose: Convert objective-ledger misses into precise evidence gaps and source-backed remediation routes.
input_contract: Learner supplies objective status and dimension-level misses, not private notes or exam item text.
output_contract: Every weak objective has gap, priority, mapped lesson, official source, practice, reassessment, and stop rule.

purpose: Choose safe remediation actions for unseen weak-area patterns.
input_contract: Learner receives de-identified objective evidence and attempt history.
output_contract: Learner selects the correct evidence gap, route, practice, fresh retest, and claim/action safeguard.
